judged_text: The loading view reloads every 30 seconds with no terminal failure state, while every reload of /embed/best re-enqueues a RetrieveTopic job (embed_controller.rb:15). When retrieval can never succeed (embed_by_username unset or misspelled, remote fetch error, misconfigured feed URL), every viewer polls the forum and re-enqueues a job every 30 seconds indefinitely, with no error surfaced to the admin, the embedding site, or the reader.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading view uses `setTimeout(document.location.reload, 30000)` with no terminal error state (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb). If retrieval never succeeds (e.g., `embed_by_username` missing/invalid, remote fetch fails, feed misconfigured), the page will reload forever and each reload will enqueue another `RetrieveTopic` job. Although `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` throttles the *fetch* to once per 60s, it does not prevent repeated job enqueues/executions, so many viewers can still create unbounded background job churn with no surfaced error.
